state_condition: Selected TOP SOC has at least one valid FROZEN source path and valid value.
candidate_preservation_rule: Return selected inferred TOP SOC; no claim of confirmed/current employment.
exposure_value_behavior: Return unchanged source-attributed values in source_records; relationship interpretation mandatory.
required_provenance: Profile/system contract fields plus each candidate/source field when applicable; nullability per exposure_provenance_contract_v1.csv.
user_facing_interpretation: Operational historical counterpart for EQUIVALENT; contextual historical source-category reference for broader/overlap.
unavailable_error_behavior: INSUFFICIENT: LOOKUP_NOT_PERFORMED_INSUFFICIENT_INFERENCE. Otherwise missing mapping: UNAVAILABLE_NO_DEFENSIBLE_FROZEN_MAPPING; missing/invalid value: UNAVAILABLE_SOURCE_EXPOSURE_VALUE. Artifact failure overrides successful result, fails closed with ARTIFACT_VALIDATION_FAILURE and no numeric fallback.

state_condition: Selected TOP SOC has zero valid valued FROZEN paths.
candidate_preservation_rule: Retain selected inferred SOC and title even when exposure unavailable.
exposure_value_behavior: Exposure null; retain invalid/missing frozen source records with unavailable reasons if any.
required_provenance: Profile/system contract fields plus each candidate/source field when applicable; nullability per exposure_provenance_contract_v1.csv.
user_facing_interpretation: Historical exposure unavailable; occupation remains inferred.
unavailable_error_behavior: INSUFFICIENT: LOOKUP_NOT_PERFORMED_INSUFFICIENT_INFERENCE. Otherwise missing mapping: UNAVAILABLE_NO_DEFENSIBLE_FROZEN_MAPPING; missing/invalid value: UNAVAILABLE_SOURCE_EXPOSURE_VALUE. Artifact failure overrides successful result, fails closed with ARTIFACT_VALIDATION_FAILURE and no numeric fallback.

state_condition: All eligible SOCs have at least one valid valued FROZEN path; eligible denominator greater than zero.
candidate_preservation_rule: Preserve every candidate_eligible=TRUE SOC; audit rank/evidence retained, no automatic winner.
exposure_value_behavior: Return each SOC independently with all frozen source records; no profile scalar.
required_provenance: Profile/system contract fields plus each candidate/source field when applicable; nullability per exposure_provenance_contract_v1.csv.
user_facing_interpretation: All candidate paths available; occupation remains unresolved and coverage is not confidence.
unavailable_error_behavior: INSUFFICIENT: LOOKUP_NOT_PERFORMED_INSUFFICIENT_INFERENCE. Otherwise missing mapping: UNAVAILABLE_NO_DEFENSIBLE_FROZEN_MAPPING; missing/invalid value: UNAVAILABLE_SOURCE_EXPOSURE_VALUE. Artifact failure overrides successful result, fails closed with ARTIFACT_VALIDATION_FAILURE and no numeric fallback.

state_condition: At least one but fewer than all eligible SOCs have a valid valued FROZEN path.
candidate_preservation_rule: Preserve every eligible SOC including every unmapped SOC; full denominator mandatory.
exposure_value_behavior: Per-SOC source values where available, explicit null/reason otherwise; no profile scalar.
required_provenance: Profile/system contract fields plus each candidate/source field when applicable; nullability per exposure_provenance_contract_v1.csv.
user_facing_interpretation: Report mapped/total availability, e.g. 2/3; never interpret as 66.7% confidence.
unavailable_error_behavior: INSUFFICIENT: LOOKUP_NOT_PERFORMED_INSUFFICIENT_INFERENCE. Otherwise missing mapping: UNAVAILABLE_NO_DEFENSIBLE_FROZEN_MAPPING; missing/invalid value: UNAVAILABLE_SOURCE_EXPOSURE_VALUE. Artifact failure overrides successful result, fails closed with ARTIFACT_VALIDATION_FAILURE and no numeric fallback.

state_condition: No eligible SOC has a valid valued FROZEN path; eligible denominator greater than zero.
candidate_preservation_rule: Preserve every eligible SOC with rank/evidence and explicit unavailable reason.
exposure_value_behavior: All historical exposure values null; no numeric defaults or fallback.
required_provenance: Profile/system contract fields plus each candidate/source field when applicable; nullability per exposure_provenance_contract_v1.csv.
user_facing_interpretation: Occupation unresolved; historical exposure unavailable for every retained eligible SOC.
unavailable_error_behavior: INSUFFICIENT: LOOKUP_NOT_PERFORMED_INSUFFICIENT_INFERENCE. Otherwise missing mapping: UNAVAILABLE_NO_DEFENSIBLE_FROZEN_MAPPING; missing/invalid value: UNAVAILABLE_SOURCE_EXPOSURE_VALUE. Artifact failure overrides successful result, fails closed with ARTIFACT_VALIDATION_FAILURE and no numeric fallback.

state_condition: Frozen inference abstains, regardless of diagnostic TOP fields or audit candidates.
candidate_preservation_rule: Retain original inference status and eligible audit count; candidate audit references may remain diagnostics only; exposure candidate results empty.
exposure_value_behavior: All exposure fields null; source_records empty; no historical/source lookup.
required_provenance: Profile/system contract fields plus each candidate/source field when applicable; nullability per exposure_provenance_contract_v1.csv.
user_facing_interpretation: Occupation inference unavailable or insufficient evidence; clarification can create a new context only.
